screen: Completed earlier training calls only. Deduplicate masks on that training membership; reference positions use $20-or-volume-limit, fees and 10% sale cost, with returns clipped to [-1,1]. Compare first eligible call per contract and equally weighted calls within equally weighted contracts. Require twelve contracts and a positive reference mean. Rank the larger mean-minus-dispersion score. Retain two configurations per identical training mask, then at most sixteen candidates per group and six per observation window. This is a heuristic shortlist, not exhaustive portfolio optimization or a confidence interval.
selection: Ordinary selectors need ten entered trades/eight contracts, positive returns at both 5% and 10% sale costs and the stated training drawdown bound. Maximize 10%-cost return. Strict selectors also need fourteen trades/ten contracts/three trading days and positive 10%-cost results without two best training contracts and without the best entry day. Cash is allowed. The final full-data fit is not an additional evaluation day.
execution: Enter 1/15/60 seconds after the fixed completed observation window, using the next observed second within ten seconds. Holds of 15–300 seconds, one-second sale reaction and ten-second fill wait; missing sales are written off. One position and one purchase per contract. $1,000 account, 1% prior-quote economic volume, five-second indexing lag and five prior swaps; twice prior median gas/MEV fees plus sale haircut. Pre-quote capacity/fees may be stale at later entry times. Sizing compares flat, observed-window volatility/activity and prior-cohort weights with 1%/2.5%/5% fractions and no/2%/4% daily full-loss budgets.
scope: Previously examined dates and the separate expanded 1,506-call cache. Search original recoverable calls, all 406 added calls and their combination separately. Price windows are rebuilt from one-second data for all groups. Unavailable original message versions restrict coverage. The earlier frozen candidates and fresh validation data are unchanged.
